gloss: an ideal accepted by some individual or group
rationale: An ideal or principle is a Concept accepted by a group, not a collection of information items.

gloss: large feline of African and Asian forests usually having a tawny coat with black spots
rationale: A leopard is a wild animal and a living organism; the assignment is correct.

gloss: a piece of armor plate (with eye slits) fixed or hinged to a medieval helmet to protect the face
rationale: A visor is a designed piece of armor made with a specific protective purpose, not just any physical object.

gloss: any substance characterized by its great flammability
rationale: Pyrogen is defined as a type of substance with a characteristic property; dul:Substance is appropriate.

gloss: marked by strong resentment or cynicism
rationale: Acrimony is a quality/attribute expressing emotional state (resentment, cynicism).

gloss: a horse trained to a special gait in which both feet on one side leave the ground together
rationale: A pacer is a trained horse, which is a living organism.

gloss: a fully differentiated structural and functional unit in an animal that is specialized for some particular function
rationale: An organ is a biological part/unit within an organism, not the organism itself.

gloss: worry unnecessarily or excessively
rationale: Worrying excessively is an active behavior/event, not a static cognitive state like believing something.

gloss: for a limitless time
rationale: The gloss describes temporal extent; dul:TimeInterval is more specific than generic dul:Region.

gloss: twining shrub of North America having yellow capsules enclosing scarlet seeds
rationale: A shrub is a living plant organism; the assignment is correct.

gloss: (baseball) the person who plays the position of catcher
rationale: The gloss explicitly identifies a catcher as a person. dul:Person is correct.

gloss: advocating or following the socialist principles
rationale: Socialistic is a quality describing a viewpoint or characteristic; dul:Quality is appropriate.

gloss: sharpen with a hone
rationale: Sharpening is an intentional action performed with a tool (hone).

gloss: (psychology) an urge to withdraw or avoid a situation or an object
rationale: Abience is explicitly a psychological phenomenon; dul:CognitiveEvent may be more specific than generic dul:Event.

gloss: having a spiny stem
rationale: Spiny-stemmed describes a physical characteristic; dul:Quality is correct.

gloss: drawing of a human or animal that represents the head by a circle and the rest of the body by straight lines
rationale: A stick figure is a physical drawing that realizes/expresses a representation of a person.

gloss: perceive to be the same
rationale: Recognition is a cognitive event involving perception and identification.

gloss: (in flight formation) a position to the side and just to the rear of another aircraft
rationale: A wing position is a spatial region/location in a flight formation.

gloss: a beam built up from boards; has a hollow rectangular cross section
rationale: A box beam is a manufactured structural component designed for specific purposes.

gloss: understand the meaning of
rationale: Understanding/comprehension is an event of grasping meaning, not a stable state like knowing.

gloss: the mansion of a lord or wealthy person
rationale: A manor is a building designed and constructed for residence by nobility.

gloss: excessive hairiness
rationale: Hirsuteness is a quality/property describing excessive hair.

gloss: completely hairless
rationale: Depilous describes a quality/characteristic (being hairless).

gloss: Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
rationale: Pizza is a food substance with a functional purpose (consumable).

gloss: equip with a fuse; provide with a fuse
rationale: Equipping something with a fuse is an intentional action performed by an agent.

gloss: at no time hereafter
rationale: The gloss describes a temporal extent; dul:TimeInterval would be more specific than generic dul:Region.

gloss: an underground banking system based on trust whereby money can be made available internationally without actually moving it or leaving a record of the transaction
rationale: Hawala is a system/protocol for transferring value, not a structured group of agents. dul:Plan or dul:Method better captures a procedure.

gloss: custard sauce flavored with vanilla or a liqueur
rationale: Creme anglais is a culinary substance (sauce) with a functional purpose.

gloss: a baseball player on the team at bat who is on base (or attempting to reach a base)
rationale: A base runner is explicitly a person (baseball player) in a specific role.

gloss: familiar with many parts of the world
rationale: Traveled describes a quality characteristic (having traveled/experienced).

gloss: register the trademark of
rationale: Registering a trademark is an intentional action performed by an agent.

gloss: occurring immediately after birth
rationale: Postnatal describes a temporal quality (occurring after birth).

gloss: a trivalent metallic element of the rare earth group; occurs with yttrium
rationale: Erbium is a chemical element and compound; dul:ChemicalObject is appropriate.

gloss: a means of enforcement
rationale: A means of enforcement is a method/mechanism, not an action itself.

gloss: enter or take spoils from someone else territory
rationale: A foray is an intentional action involving entering and taking.

gloss: a plug for connecting a telephone
rationale: A telephone plug is a manufactured connector designed for a specific purpose.

gloss: the quantity contained in a pitcher
rationale: This sense refers to a quantity/measure, not the object; dul:Amount is correct.

gloss: not less than
rationale: At least marks a region in a quantity/value space (boundary of quantification).

gloss: a disorder of the nervous system
rationale: A nervous disorder is a complex state of affairs involving the nervous system.

gloss: mixture of two or more whiskeys or of a whiskey and neutral spirits
rationale: Blended whiskey is a beverage substance with a functional purpose.

gloss: through a range downward
rationale: Under marks a spatial region/direction (downward/below).

gloss: unsatisfactoriness by virtue of being inadequate
rationale: Inadequacy is a quality/property describing insufficiency.

gloss: grow anew or continue growth after an injury or interruption
rationale: Regrowth involves gradual change over time; dul:Process better captures this than the homogeneous dul:State.

gloss: cultivated land that is not seeded for one or more growing seasons
rationale: Fallow describes land in a particular condition, not a substance; dul:Place captures the location/land better.
